segments.rule: Each clean 4 s (2000-sample) epoch is split into two non-overlapping 2 s segments [0, 1000) and [1000, 2000). All clean segments of a subject are used together (both classes pooled; deviation D16).

connectivity.note: 2 s segments: 0.5 Hz bins; 2 Hz full bandwidth -> NW = 2, 3 tapers. mne_connectivity selects f_lower <= f <= f_upper, so each band uses fmax = hi - 0.25 Hz to make bands half-open [lo, hi) on the 0.5 Hz grid.

delta_note: With 2 s segments the 5-cycle frequency is 2.5 Hz; delta bins below it are less reliable (mne_connectivity warns). Recorded as a limitation, not changed.
edges_rule: All unordered channel pairs within a set, named A-B in the set's channel order (extended 231 edges, core 28). Computed once on the extended set; core edges are the same values (wpli2_debiased is pairwise).
missing_rule: Edge NaN (no imputation) when: an endpoint is in info['bads'] (unavailable pair); or an endpoint belongs to a homologous pair whose two channels were both interpolated at any stage (D14, the channel is treated as unavailable); or both endpoints were interpolated (no edge computed from interpolated data on both ends). Edges with exactly one interpolated endpoint are kept and flagged in the edge-flag file (Step 8 sensitivity).
clipping: Feature tables store the raw (possibly negative) debiased values; Step 5 graph metrics clip negatives to 0. The fraction of negative available edges is recorded per subject, band and set.

surrogates.rule: For each surrogate, the segment order of the right-hemisphere channels is permuted by a random derangement (no segment keeps its true partner) while left channels keep theirs; wpli2_debiased is recomputed for the homologous edges only. Observed homotopic value 'exceeds' when > the subject's 95th-percentile surrogate, per pair and for the mean over available pairs (extended 11 pairs and core 4 pairs).

segment_count_check: Label-free Spearman rho of every connectivity feature and homotopic mean with the number of segments, across included subjects.
